caption:
Scheduling your posts does not affect your reach. Mosseri said it in a March 2025 Q&A — scheduled posts "will not affect your reach one way or the other" — and repeated it on March 19, 2026.

This myth costs people more than they realise. Alarms set for 7am. Holidays interrupted. Content held back because the "right" posting window passed. All of it to appease a rule that does not exist.

And there's an edge in the other direction: Mosseri pointed out that scheduling actually gives Instagram time to process AI translations, so every language version of your post is ready the moment it goes live. Schedule it and your content reaches more people, not fewer.

Two other things that changed in 2026 and are worth knowing: scheduling opened to every public account in March, no professional mode needed. And Trial Reels became schedulable in April.

The calendar is not the enemy. Posting from a place of panic is.
